dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape with a medium pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50 to 60 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Gentle, large-radius convex curve forming the dorsal-anterior cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion extending anteriorly from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle visible at the transition between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan false-color luminosity across entire visible surface; digital aliasing present on fin and fluke margins.
